key_facts: 12-month history of left-sided nasal congestion and obstruction
Large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity on physical examination
Soft tissue polypoid density on Computed Tomographic Imaging
Gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization
No local or distant metastatic disease on additional studies

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138-positive and CD56-positive staining, along with EBV-positivity and the absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, are characteristic features of plasmablastic lymphoma. The gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH), also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Nasal type extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Although EBV-positive, the CD56-positive staining could be seen in this entity, but the presence of CD138 and the specific genetic alterations point more towards plasmablastic lymphoma.

rejected.label: Burkitt lymphoma
rejected.why: Typically CD20-positive and PAX5-positive, which contradicts the pathological analysis provided.

rejected.label: Extramedullary plasmacytoma
rejected.why: Would typically be CD20-negative and PAX5-negative but usually lacks the EBV-positivity and specific genetic alterations seen in plasmablastic lymphoma.

rejected.label: Lymphadenopathy
rejected.why: This is a symptom or finding rather than a specific diagnosis and does not explain the specific pathological and genetic findings.

rejected.label: Rhinitis
rejected.why: This condition does not account for the large polypoid mass, the specific pathological staining, or the genetic alterations found in the case.
